name: sf-trace
description: SF-TRACE: an open model of transit ridership and travel choices in San Francisco

scripts.build:wasm: asc wasm/blocks.ts -O3 --runtime stub --importMemory --noAssert --enable simd --outFile wasm/blocks.wasm && asc wasm/search.ts -O3 --runtime stub --importMemory --noAssert --enable simd --outFile wasm/search.wasm && node wasm/embed.mjs blocks search
scripts.model:fetch: tsx server/beta3/pipeline/fetch-data.ts && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/fetch-osm.ts && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/fetch-elevation.ts && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/fetch-micromobility.ts
scripts.model:build: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=3072 sh -c "tsx server/beta3/pipeline/streets.ts && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/zones.ts && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/synpop-seed.ts && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/synpop.ts && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/transit.ts && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/skims.ts && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/micromob-skims.ts && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/build.ts && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/streets-bundle.ts"
scripts.model:calibrate: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 sh -c "tsx server/beta3/pipeline/calibrate.ts && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/micromob-fit.ts && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/autoown.ts && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/build.ts && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/calibrate-autoown.ts && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/baseline.ts && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/roads.ts && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/road-shapes.ts && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/roads-base.ts && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/gateways.ts"
scripts.model:runmodes: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 sh -c "tsx server/beta3/pipeline/runmodes.ts run --mode precise && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/runmodes.ts run --mode quick && tsx server/beta3/pipeline/runmodes.ts combine"
